status: Draft. Probe results and upstream source read as text, recorded 2026-11-04 for draft/OPENCODE-2-MIGRATION-PLAN.md §4 A6. Not Surface evidence: the 2.x census must capture every row again.

sources.definitions: packages/schema/src/**/*.ts at v2.2.5: every Event.durable/Event.ephemeral call, read as text. Same-file spreads are resolved, both plain field objects and `Name.fields` of a `Schema.Struct`; a spread from another file is kept as `spread` (only `session.moved`: `SessionInbox.MovePayload.fields`, session-inbox.ts)
sources.publicTypes: `types` enum of GET /api/event in the 2.2.5 /openapi.json (sha256 f5c4571b…, byte-identical on linux-x64 and darwin-arm64)
sources.observed: 288 frames from the 2026-11-03/04 probes: probe:22 and probe:31 (model-free lifecycle, permission/form, reconnect), a5:a-* (three fake-provider turns in each of three config shapes), and the MCP and credential frames a5:b-ext, a5:b-ext-compat and a5:b-auth kept (those probes did not keep their whole stream). `seenIn` names the captures per type; an unobserved type is `null`

transport.auth: HTTP Basic, user `opencode`, password from OPENCODE_PASSWORD (falls back to OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD); 401 `{_tag:"UnauthorizedError"}`
transport.framing: every record is one `data: <json>` block; never `id:`, `event:` or `retry:`
transport.heartbeat: `: heartbeat` comment on connect and every 15 s

filter.values: any public type, or a string matching "^rpc\\.[\\s\\S]*?$"

transport.replay: none: Last-Event-ID, ?after, ?cursor, ?seq ignored; events during a disconnection are lost (probe:30)
transport.overflow: one bounded queue per subscriber (4096); on overflow the subscriber is removed and its stream fails (EventFeed.SubscriberOverflow)
transport.sessionLog: GET /api/experimental/session/{id}/log?after=<seq>&follow= returns only one `log.synced` frame under `opencode serve`, which never persists events (probe:20, probe:30)

fields.location: optional Location.Ref ({directory}); present on some session.* and catalog events
fields.data: event payload: a JSON object on the wire, although the OpenAPI declares V2EventEncoded as a JSON-encoded string; decoders must accept both
fields.durable: durable events only: {aggregateID, seq (from 0 per aggregate), version (the definition version)}

envelope.seqGapRule: a per-aggregate seq gap is the signal to rehydrate over REST (§2.3)

events.note: not in the `types` enum; always sent first

data.name: sessionID
data.schema: SessionID.annotate({ description: "Session ID to navigate to" })

legacyV1.$comment: packages/schema/src/v1/** keeps 1.x-named definitions in the full manifest for the in-place V1 migration. None of the 1.x-only names is on the public stream.
